distance.note: Distance bands are PROVISIONAL engineering defaults, not empirically calibrated for Nigeria. Distance never overrides a failed science gate. Long baselines may yield FLOAT-only metre-level results; decisions communicate degraded expectations without claiming guaranteed accuracy.
